high_level_description: The image features a stylized graphic with a black background. The character has a predominantly black color scheme with orange accents on its ears and eyes, giving it a fierce and intense appearance. Surrounding the heart, the text "I ❤️ My Boyfriend" is written in a playful, cursive font. The heart symbol is replaced by the letter "❤️," which is commonly used to represent love or affection.
